tokens.name: table
tokens.usage: The game table and app background: sea-green baize, a mid tone so paper, gorse and heather cards all stand off it. Always used with the felt treatment: a lamp-pool glow and a fine grain.

tokens.name: table-glow
tokens.usage: Centre of the lamp-pool glow on `table`, fading out by 70% of the screen. Draws the eye to the middle of the board.

tokens.name: table-grain
tokens.usage: Fine felt grain over `table`: soft noise, no shapes or edges. Texture only; never carries meaning.

tokens.name: table-grid
tokens.usage: Empty-cell outlines on `table` where a lone verb could go.

tokens.name: river-bed
tokens.usage: The river band: a sunken channel behind the five piles. Pile counts on it are `ink`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Status strip, hand tray, sheets and the setup panels.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Toasts, dialogs, menus and secondary buttons above `surface`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and control borders on `surface` and `surface-raised`; 3:1 on both in each theme is not required as they never carry meaning alone.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `table`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `meaning-paper`(light).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (English glosses in UI, captions, counts' labels) on `table`, `surface`, `surface-raised`: at least 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill (Lay it, Play, Continue). Deliberately not a card colour so actions never read as cards.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `action`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px gap in the ground colour, then 3px solid `focus`. 3:1 on table, surfaces and every card fill.

tokens.name: lit
tokens.usage: Line-builder highlight ring on targets that can complete the selected line (shown-answers mode only). Pulses; same hue as focus because both mean 'you can act here'.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Refusals and errors: the wrong-line reason, the shake toast, update failures. Always paired with an icon and words.

tokens.name: alert-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an alert toast; `alert` text reads on it in both themes.

tokens.name: verb
tokens.usage: Verb card face (gorse). Hub cards. Text is `on-verb`.

tokens.name: verb-edge
tokens.usage: Verb card edge and the verb glyph.

tokens.name: verb-notch
tokens.usage: The four arm notches on a verb card, tone on tone: lines leave it in any direction.

tokens.name: on-verb
tokens.usage: Words on `verb` (10:1).

tokens.name: adverb
tokens.usage: Adverb card face (deep heather): amach, isteach, suas, síos. Square notches on the ends of its line. Gorse and heather: the colours of the hills. Text is `on-adverb`.

tokens.name: adverb-edge
tokens.usage: Adverb card edge; in dark it lightens so the card separates from `table`.

tokens.name: adverb-notch
tokens.usage: The two square notches on an adverb card, tone on tone.

tokens.name: on-adverb
tokens.usage: Words on `adverb` (10:1).

tokens.name: preposition
tokens.usage: Preposition card face (pale heather): ar, le, do, as, de, faoi, ó. Round notches on the ends of its line. Particles share heather; adverbs dark, prepositions pale, so they differ in lightness, not hue alone. Text is `on-preposition`.

tokens.name: preposition-edge
tokens.usage: Preposition card edge.

tokens.name: preposition-notch
tokens.usage: The two round notches on a preposition card, tone on tone.

tokens.name: on-preposition
tokens.usage: Words on `preposition` (12:1).

tokens.name: meaning-paper
tokens.usage: Meaning card face. Larger card in hand; on the table it shows one meaning. Text is `meaning-ink` and `meaning-answer`.

tokens.name: meaning-edge
tokens.usage: Meaning card edge and the hairlines between its three meanings.

tokens.name: meaning-ink
tokens.usage: English meanings on `meaning-paper`.

tokens.name: meaning-answer
tokens.usage: Irish answers on `meaning-paper` (bog brown, 9:1). The Irish is the hero: larger than the English.

tokens.name: wild
tokens.usage: Wildcard face: a pale slate with a dashed border, notches on the ends of its line, and no word. Text and glyph `on-wild`.

tokens.name: wild-edge
tokens.usage: Wildcard dashed border.

tokens.name: on-wild
tokens.usage: Glyph and the stands-for particle shown on tap, on `wild`.

tokens.name: card-back
tokens.usage: Backs of hand-deck cards and the meaning pile when face down (peat).

tokens.name: player-1
tokens.usage: Player 1 (rust): avatar, ownership marker, recap rows. Always with pattern `solid` and an initial.

tokens.name: player-2
tokens.usage: Player 2 (lough blue). Pattern `stripes`.

tokens.name: player-3
tokens.usage: Player 3 (moss). Pattern `dots`.

tokens.name: player-4
tokens.usage: Player 4 (rose). Pattern `chevrons`.

tokens.name: on-player
tokens.usage: Initials on a player-colour avatar in both themes.

styles.name: card-hand
styles.usage: Verb and particle words on hand cards (76px).

styles.name: card-table
styles.usage: Table cards at 100% zoom (64px). Below 32px zoom the word gives way to the type glyph.

styles.name: answer
styles.usage: Irish answers on meaning cards and in the compound toast.

styles.name: celebrate
styles.usage: The compound on the line-made moment.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Wordmark and the winner line on the recap.

styles.name: meaning
styles.usage: English meanings on meaning cards in the hand, in capitals.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary lines, helper text, toast glosses. Nothing read during play goes smaller.

styles.name: count
styles.usage: Hand and pile counts; set with tabular numerals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked pile layers; icon-to-text inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between hand cards and between river piles.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside the status strip and toasts.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter (plus safe-area inset); padding in sheets.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between setup groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections; top of recap.

tokens.name: radius-card-sm
tokens.usage: Table cards (64px).

tokens.name: radius-card-md
tokens.usage: River cards (60px).

tokens.name: radius-card-lg
tokens.usage: Hand cards (76px) and meaning cards in hand.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, segmented controls, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and dialogs (top corners).

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Avatars and count badges.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: A card at rest on the table, river or hand.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A selected hand card (lifted 8px) and a card in flight.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Hand tray and bottom sheets.

size.note: Card and touch sizes in CSS px (= pt on iOS).

tokens.name: card-hand
tokens.usage: Verb, particle and wildcard cards in the hand tray.

tokens.name: card-meaning-w
tokens.usage: Meaning card width in the hand tray: a wide card so all three meanings read at full size.

tokens.name: card-meaning-h
tokens.usage: Meaning card height in the hand tray.

tokens.name: card-river
tokens.usage: River pile tops. Also the touch target.

tokens.name: card-table
tokens.usage: Board cell at 100% zoom (66px pitch). The board opens on the area around the latest play; zoom runs 26px to 96px, and below 32px words become type glyphs.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target in hand tray, river and controls.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons. Segmented controls are 44px.

duration.note: Motion timings; reduced motion swaps flights for 120ms fades.

tokens.name: dur-snap
tokens.usage: Card lift, select, press feedback, fades under reduced motion.

tokens.name: dur-place
tokens.usage: A card flying from hand or river into its cell during line placement.

tokens.name: dur-celebrate
tokens.usage: The line-made moment: the compound pops large, holds, then settles into the toast. Never blocks the next tap.

tokens.name: dur-bot
tokens.usage: Per card when a bot lays a line, so the eye can follow.

tokens.name: dur-stall
tokens.usage: River rotation on a stall (top card slides under).

tokens.name: dur-pulse
tokens.usage: One cycle of the lit-target pulse.

tokens.name: ease-snap
tokens.usage: Card arrivals: a little overshoot, like a card slapped down.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Sheets, toasts, river rotation.
